column3: Produce a flagship launch video showcasing the revamped InterviewProof platform and full agentic function. Cinematic, high-production-value asset designed to anchor the entire relaunch narrative. Gate: produce only once Diagnostic Analysis UI Redesign & Full Agentic Function (F-001) ships.

Once the launch video is live, lead the Instagram push: post the launch video, cut short-form derivatives (Reels, teasers, behind-the-scenes), and run paid boost campaigns to drive reach and early traction. Depends on M-001 completion.

Cross-post the launch video natively on Twitter/X and LinkedIn alongside the Instagram push. Tailor copy and framing per platform (founder-led narrative on Twitter, professional/career-growth angle on LinkedIn). Drive comments, reposts, and inbound interest.

After the launch video and Instagram campaign build credibility and traction, begin targeting distribution channels — career services offices, bootcamps, creator partnerships, newsletters, and community partnerships. Leverage early social proof and traction metrics as the pitch.
